title: Fantastic Tour
text:
I took the tour with my mother (she is 82).  we very much enjoyed our day with Nadim the fantastic tour guide. He was very attentive to our needs.  His  knowledge of Barcelona city is amazing !  He brought us to the best ice cream and coffee place in Barcelona.  If you plan to visit, ask for him you won't be disappointed !

Furthermore, we had dealings  with Albert from "Unique Dreamers" ( the tour agency) who did everything he could to accommodate us.

Thank you Nadim and Albert!
author: Michel M

title: Amazing tour! You get to see the...
text: Amazing tour! You get to see the city, the history, and the church all in one day! Our tour guide was great too. I recomend to all wanting to know more about the city. We had a great time.
author: Larissa M

title: Wonderful day with Allan
text: Allan did a wonderful job of making the history, culture, and joy of Barcelona come to life! We had a 7-hour tour that covered a lot of ground, and Allan kept our attention for the whole day. He was able to effectively engage both of our 12 year-olds while providing new insights and information for our 21 year-old who has been living in Barcelona for the past 4 months. Allan met us at the hotel promptly at 9:00 and then we were off for lots of adventures. We enjoyed our time sharing lunch with Allan and learning more about his life along with some of the Spanish cultures that blend together so
author: JPluimer
